warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque D165 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D rebuild.

Because the Range Rover Evoque D165 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover Evoque 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established Ingenium AJ200D / AJ150D specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
